text:
A court would likely hold that no contract was formed yet. The catalog was an invitation to deal rather than an offer, so Marty's purchase order was the offer, and Costco's "acceptance conditional upon a loading charge" is most likely a counteroffer under UCC § 2-207 because its "conditional upon" wording signals it will not proceed without the extra charge. A contract would arise only if one party later performs by shipping or accepting the envelopes, and then it would likely be on the $1,000 terms, with the $50-per-thousand charge excluded.

CONFIDENCE: 60
